newsitem.title: GERMANY: Metro falls to losses after CEO comment.
newsitem.headline: Metro falls to losses after CEO comment.

text.p: Shares in Metro AG slumped in bourse dealings on Wednesday after the German retail group said expectations were too high for its shares.

Metro shares ended bourse trade down 7.40 marks at 209 marks and well off the session high of 228 marks, which was a new record high for the retailer. Metro shares extended their losses in IBIS computer trade, falling to 207.60 marks.
The DAX index, meanwhile, ended bourse trade up 49.46 points at 4,055.86 points, a gain of 1.2 percent.
Metro chief executive Klaus Wiegandt set off the selling with his comments at the group's annual meeting, traders said.
The losses came despite Goldman Sachs on Wednesday raising its rating of Metro shares to "market outperformer" from "market performer".
